items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: I can't think of who his drummer was at that time.

ctx.x: No, this is way after Chani time, Chani, that's been the year after that.
Was it when Zaire was with him or after?
I can't think of who his drummer was at that time. Must have been one of those good ones.
